title: Use dataclass instead of namedtuple for reduction status.
description: This fixes a few mypy errors.

review_comments.author: tysmith
review_comments.body: Is `tuple()` needed here? The type hint says `formatters` is already a `tuple`.

review_comments.author: jschwartzentruber
review_comments.body: Nope, it isn't. I initially had changed the signature to `Iterable` but that added errors because you can't `len()` an `Iterable`.
